slides.texte_overlay:
What every man should know
before getting serious with someone
Know what you want. A partner, a family, a city, a lifestyle. Being clear about your future avoids years of confusion for both of you.
Know how you handle conflict. Do you shut down, shout or run away? Understanding yourself helps you fight fair when it matters.
Know that love needs effort. The excitement of the beginning fades. Daily kindness, attention and respect are what make it last.
Know your own family patterns. How your parents argued, loved and solved problems shapes you. Notice what you want to keep and what to change.
Before: I had little to bring to deep conversations. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and we never run out of things to share.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I had little to bring to deep conversations. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. We never run out of things to share.

slides.texte_overlay: Know that trust is built slowly. Keep promises, be on time, be honest even when it's uncomfortable. Trust is made of small moments.
Know that you're still responsible for your own happiness. A partner adds to your life. They can't fix everything in it.
